summary: OMP conversations show complete disclosures, readable timestamps and retryable failed opens across terminal and phone

replay.detail: No replay cursor or spool format changes.

schema.detail: No database schema, indexes or migrations change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or fleet coordination changes.

compatibility.detail: Native OMP timestamps are normalized for existing conversation views; oversized records retain readable previews and image metadata; subagent transcript lookup accepts linked companion directories but refuses symlinked transcript entries. Terminal and phone show hidden-line disclosures and failed-open retry states. Existing client wire shapes and harness protocols are retained, including phone inline text selection and freshness indicators.

downtime.detail: No coordinated restart or added startup work is required.

manual.detail: No configuration changes or manual upgrade steps are required.

recovery.detail: No state repair or graph recovery is required.
